races.paceDynamic: Blue Siam and Siorai will contest the early lead, with Blue Siam's proven front-running style likely to dominate early despite her recent struggles. The honest gallop these two create should suit the hold-up horses like Watamu, Rose Light, and Footage Detectives who can use their finishing kicks. With multiple prominent racers like Tangled Webb, Alibey, and Nowherenearmilan tracking the pace, this sets up perfectly for late closers if the early tempo is strong enough.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Siam and Siorai go too slow early and kick clear
scenarios.body: The front two get an easy lead and have enough left to hold off late challengers. Prominent racers like Alibey and Tangled Webb can't bridge the gap from their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Siam and Siorai engage in a genuine battle from the start
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for Watamu and Rose Light to unleash their finishing kicks from the rear. Footage Detectives could also benefit despite her tendency to fade if she times her run correctly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Take Control
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: Tangled Webb and Alibey can track the leaders perfectly and kick clear before the hold-up horses get into gear. Nowherenearmilan's similar style could also capitalize if she finds her best form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a tactical affair with multiple pace changes
scenarios.body: Lower-rated horses like Minnie Belle or Burning Embers get conditions to suit their running styles. The tactical nature catches out some favorites who prefer straightforward gallops.

watchPoints.text: Blue Siam and Siorai could steal this if they get an uncontested lead early given their front-running styles
Footage Detectives and Simply A Dancer both show concerning fade patterns that could repeat under pressure
Watamu's hold-up style depends entirely on Blue Siam and Siorai creating enough early pace to set up her finish
Nowherenearmilan has failed to win or place in two recent runs on similar going conditions
The moderate pace scenario heavily favors Tangled Webb and Alibey who can sit handy and kick first

races.name: Luke And Michaela's 1st Wedding Anniversary Selling Hurdle

runners_data.name: Demoiselle Kap
runners_data.note: Natural second-fiddle who can stalk Hecouldbetheone and has winning form on similar ground.

runners_data.name: Hecouldbetheone
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner whose recent efforts suggest he handles good ground adequately.

runners_data.name: Junker d'Allier
runners_data.note: Highest-rated with proven hold-up style but question marks after heavy ground disappointment last time.

runners_data.name: Embittered
runners_data.note: Patient type who needs strong pace to be effective and has winning form in heavy conditions.

runners_data.name: Hara Kiri
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who has won twice on testing ground this season.

runners_data.name: Disco Davis
runners_data.note: Longest-priced runner whose finishing efforts have been too little too late recently.

races.paceDynamic: Hecouldbetheone will take them along from the front with Demoiselle Kap likely tracking in second, creating a controlled tempo over this extended trip. With four hold-up horses (Junker d'Allier, Embittered, Hara Kiri, Disco Davis) bunched behind, the race sets up for a cavalry charge from the final hurdle where positioning and stamina will prove decisive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Hecouldbetheone gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The front-runner builds a cushion turning for home and holds off the late charge. Demoiselle Kap emerges best of the chasers but cannot quite reel in the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes searching and exposes stamina limitations
scenarios.body: Junker d'Allier's superior rating tells as lesser horses fold, with the hold-up specialist timing his run perfectly. Embittered also benefits from the strong pace to finish second.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If Demoiselle Kap pressures Hecouldbetheone early and creates stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The uneven tempo plays into the hands of the patient hold-up horses who get first run on the leaders. Hara Kiri and Embittered benefit most from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or interference disrupts the natural rhythm and running order
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning compromised throughout the field. Disco Davis or another outsider can capitalize on the chaos while favorites struggle to recover.

watchPoints.text: Junker d'Allier's jumping under pressure after that heavy ground fall could determine if class prevails
Hecouldbetheone's early fractions will dictate whether hold-up horses get their preferred strong pace
Demoiselle Kap's positioning behind the leader as any early pressure could compromise both front-runners
How quickly Embittered and Hara Kiri are switched for their runs given the small field size
Disco Davis jumping cleanly as errors have cost him in recent outings when needing every advantage

runners_data.name: Lunar Discovery
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid similar going record (1W 1P from 3 runs) who should appreciate the likely tactical nature

runners_data.name: Classic King
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up performer with strong similar going form (1W 5P from 6 runs) and highest official rating in field

runners_data.name: Tapley
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner with excellent recent good ground form including two wins from last five starts

runners_data.name: Happy And Fine
runners_data.note: Sole front runner who will dictate terms but recent form shows mixed results on softer surfaces

runners_data.name: Kilbarry Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent runs have all been on softer ground, making good going form uncertain

races.paceDynamic: Happy And Fine as the sole confirmed front runner will set the tempo without pressure from the flag. With Tapley the only prominent runner and three confirmed hold-up horses (Lunar Discovery, Classic King, Kilbarry Hill), this creates a tactical affair where the pace will be steady early before quickening from three out as the closers make their moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Happy And Fine gets an easy lead and finds a rhythm
scenarios.body: Happy And Fine builds a decisive advantage through steady fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace plays into the hands of the hold-up horses who can unleash devastating finishing kicks. Classic King and Lunar Discovery benefit most from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Tapley tracks Happy And Fine before challenging turning in
scenarios.body: Tapley's recent good form on similar going pays dividends as he times his move perfectly from his prominent position. The hold-up horses get caught out by the change of pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway and becomes a stamina test
scenarios.body: The extended trip and good ground create a true staying challenge that sorts out the field. Kilbarry Hill's recent softer ground form doesn't translate but others struggle with the pace.

watchPoints.text: Happy And Fine getting too easy a lead early could make him very hard to peg back given the lack of pace pressure
Classic King's jumping under pressure as he was pulled up in his penultimate start over similar trip
Tapley's positioning early as he needs to be close enough to Happy And Fine to strike when the pace lifts
The hold-up horses getting organized too late if Happy And Fine quickens the pace from three out
Kilbarry Hill's adaptation to the faster good ground having raced exclusively on soft recently

races.paceDynamic: Pottersjetamay is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate a measured gallop without pressure, having shown ability to sustain pace when uncontested. The field composition creates a tactical race with numerous hold-up horses (Daring To Dream, Genbu, Peace In The Park, River Glance, Lord Of The Glance, Night Burlesque, Ritaan) needing cover and a finish, while prominent runners (Klapton Boy, No Mean Feat, Global Eclipse, Beorma) will track the leader at a respectful distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Pottersjetamay gets easy fractions and maintains stamina over this longer trip
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage turning for home while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Klapton Boy and No Mean Feat emerge as the best of the chasers but cannot reel in the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the measured early pace sets up a sprint finish for the hold-up specialists
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge from the back with multiple horses swooping late. Daring To Dream and Genbu benefit most from the tactical nature and strong stamina demands.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Changes
scenarios.trigger: If Klapton Boy or Global Eclipse decide to apply pressure to Pottersjetamay before halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favors horses with proven stamina over this distance. Peace In The Park's heavy ground form and Klapton Boy's class tell in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Incident Disrupts
scenarios.trigger: If a fall or mistake at a crucial hurdle interferes with the main protagonists
scenarios.body: The race shape completely changes with outsiders benefiting from a clear passage. Lord Of The Glance and Night Burlesque can capitalize on their recent improved form.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Klapton Boy or Global Eclipse move up to pressure Pottersjetamay early as this could completely change the race dynamic.
Monitor the jumping of Peace In The Park and Lord Of The Glance as recent winners can sometimes be over-confident at obstacles.
Observe how quickly the hold-up horses can get into contention turning for home if Pottersjetamay maintains a strong lead.
Check if Daring To Dream gets the tactical race required as the highest-rated hold-up horse in the field.
Watch for traffic problems in the straight with so many hold-up horses needing racing room simultaneously.

races.paceDynamic: Easter Icon will likely lead or press from the front with Churchman and Farhh Echo also likely to race prominently early. With seven hold-up horses including class act Harbour Light, the early pace should be sustainable rather than fierce. This sets up a tactical affair where the front runners may get first run but face a wall of closers in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Easter Icon gets an easy lead without pressure from Churchman or Farhh Echo
scenarios.body: The pace setters get first run while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on good going. Easter Icon or Churchman capitalize on their forward positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to allow the best horses to close effectively
scenarios.body: Harbour Light uses superior class (OR 100) to sweep past tiring leaders with Ballerina Boxer also finishing strongly. The prominent horses fade after making the running.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is too slow and the genuine front runners get caught flat-footed
scenarios.body: Horses racing in mid-division like Pooroldmackley and Annies Gold get the perfect trip to strike. They avoid the crawl up front and the traffic problems of the pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Lottery
scenarios.trigger: If Easter Icon goes too fast early or gets pressured into fierce gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a staying test where only the strongest stayers survive the collapse. Harbour Light's class tells but outsiders like Harksman could capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Easter Icon's early fractions will dictate whether hold-up horses can close effectively
Harbour Light needs clear running room in straight given hold-up style and class edge
Churchman's position relative to Easter Icon early will show if pace will be pressured
Track any market moves on Pooroldmackley given solid good ground record
Farhh Echo's jumping rhythm early will indicate if recent poor form continues

races.paceDynamic: Duhallow Tommy, Gotthereintheend, and Ballyhiho will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to contest the early lead. This sustained pace over 2m3½f will create a stamina test, potentially setting up the race for the hold-up horses Regal Renaissance and Two To Tango to pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Brutal Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders (Duhallow Tommy, Gotthereintheend, Ballyhiho) go too fast early
scenarios.body: The front trio will burn each other out in a speed duel, leaving the race wide open for the patient hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong. Regal Renaissance and Two To Tango can capitalize on their superior stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Gotthereintheend Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Gotthereintheend can dictate a more measured pace from the front
scenarios.body: The in-form leader can use his recent wins to rate kindly ahead of his rivals and kick clear when it matters. His soft ground form gives him the edge over the other pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Politacus Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and Politacus gets the perfect pitch in behind
scenarios.body: The prominent runner can track the leaders without getting embroiled in their early battle, then use his class advantage to strike decisively. His tactical speed from just off the pace becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ballyhiho Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the outsider can steal a march on his higher-rated rivals by getting first run
scenarios.body: Despite his lower rating, Ballyhiho's winning form on good ground and front-running style could catch the others napping. The pace pressure from behind may come too late to reel him in.

watchPoints.text: Duhallow Tommy could get caught in a speed battle with Gotthereintheend and Ballyhiho that destroys his winning chances
Regal Renaissance needs the pace to completely collapse to be effective from his hold-up style
Gotthereintheend must avoid getting drawn into early pace battle to utilize his recent winning form
Two To Tango's consistent placing record suggests he'll be involved but may lack winning punch again
Politacus sitting just behind the leaders could have the tactical advantage if pace becomes extreme

races.paceDynamic: Three confirmed front runners (Telhimlisten, Caliach Point, Moon Over Clyro) will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this 2m2½f test. The sustained pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses Juan Bermudez, Soldier's Leap, Get The Value and Morning Mayhem to finish strongly, while the pace-setters face a stamina examination.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: The front runners will weaken dramatically in the final half-mile as Juan Bermudez and Morning Mayhem sweep past. The hold-up horses will have perfect conditions to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders restrains early and gets first run
scenarios.body: Telhimlisten or Caliach Point will steal a march by kicking clear before the closers can respond. The tactical advantage will prove decisive over the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Perfect Pace Compromise
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders settle into a manageable rhythm without going crazy
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a fair test where Morning Mayhem and Soldier's Leap can showcase their class. Both form and ability will determine the outcome rather than pure tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get boxed in or delayed
scenarios.body: Oakley and Whatsgoingonmarvin will benefit from racing closer to the pace without the traffic problems. Their prominent positions will allow them to strike when the leaders weaken.

watchPoints.text: Moon Over Clyro and Caliach Point could fold quickly if the early pace becomes too strong
Juan Bermudez needs clear running room in the straight as he's prone to getting trapped
Morning Mayhem's jumping under pressure will be crucial given his hold-up style
Telhimlisten's stamina reserves will be tested if forced to make the running throughout
Get The Value's position turning for home will indicate whether he can land a blow
